description: Department of Labour Special Allowance Payable to Workers June 2025
reasoning: This gazette notification announces special allowance rates for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper industries based on the Cost of Living Index. It falls under public sector administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions administered through the Department of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance. This fits Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) which covers public service conditions, benefits, and administrative instructions related to worker compensation.
